name: Asamblea Nacional Constituyente (2017)
role: Constituent assembly that created the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios (dissolved December 2020)

name: Andrés Eloy Méndez
role: Constituent; chair of the ANC economy commission in 2019
notes: Party from a 2015 La Patilla report of his PSUV pre-candidacy; the 2019 EFE article calls him a constituyente and gives no party.

name: Luis Eduardo Martínez
role: Deputy of the National Assembly (2021 legislature); head of the Acción Democrática caucus
notes: Leads the Acción Democrática faction recognised by the Supreme Court (the party was placed under a court-appointed board in 2020), which the opposition criticises. His constituency was not confirmed, so he sits at the country level. In June 2023 he said the proposed expatriate wealth-tax law had been dropped and his faction would not vote for a similar measure.

name: Servicio Nacional Integrado de Administración Aduanera y Tributaria (Seniat)
role: Tax authority that collects the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios

name: Tania Díaz
role: Deputy of the National Assembly (PSUV, Anzoategui) since 2026; first vice-president of the 2017 Constituent Assembly; signed the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios law
notes: Full name Tania Valentina Díaz. Party from her Wikidata and public record as a PSUV figure; the Gaceta lists no party.

name: Diosdado Cabello
role: President of the Constituent Assembly 2018 to 2020
notes: Signed as president the notice of 15 August 2019 that reprinted the law; his signature on the law of 2 July 2019 itself was not readable in the copy opened.

name: Octavio Solórzano
role: President of Fenasirtrasalud, the health workers union federation

name: Orlando Camacho
role: Constituent (ANC) who presented the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios law to the assembly
notes: Party assumed from the ANC being made up of chavista militants (EFE); not stated in the source. Not the anti-corruption activist of the same name. The 2026 National Assembly list has an Orlando José Camacho Figueira (MSV, Aragua); nothing found links him to this ANC constituent, so no seat is lit.

name: Luis Britto García
role: Writer and columnist; supporter of the Bolivarian government

name: Pasqualina Curcio
role: Economist and professor at Universidad Simón Bolívar (USB)
notes: Economist and academic; in her published economic columns (Ciudad Valencia, Vocesenlucha), she recommended strengthening the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios and endorsed net wealth taxation on the rich.

name: Nicolás Maduro
role: President of Venezuela
notes: Announced and proposed the creation of the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios to the National Constituent Assembly in September 2017.

name: Gladys del Valle Requena
role: Second Vice-President of the Constituent Assembly; co-signed the Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios enactment
notes: Second Vice-President of the 2017 Constituent Assembly (alongside Diosdado Cabello and Tania Díaz); signed the official enactment and reprint of the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios in Gaceta Oficial 41.696.

name: Tony Boza
role: Economist, deputy of the National Assembly (2021-2026), former ANC constituent, and co-host of Boza con Valdez
notes: Co-author of the June 2018 policy paper Recomendaciones para atender la coyuntura economica which proposed the Impuesto de los Activos Improductivos y de los Grandes Patrimonios; co-host of Boza con Valdez on VTV.

name: Juan Carlos Valdez
role: Tax lawyer, economic analyst, and co-host of Boza con Valdez on VTV
notes: Tax attorney and economic commentator; co-host of Boza con Valdez; co-author of the June 2018 expert economic proposal recommending the tax on large wealth.

name: Luis Salas Rodríguez
role: Former Vice President for the Economy and Minister of Productive Economy; sociologist and UBV professor
notes: Former Vice-President of Economy and Minister of Productive Economy under Maduro (2016); co-authored the 2018 economic recommendations proposing the wealth tax on large fortunes.

name: María Alejandra Díaz
role: Constitutional lawyer, member of the 2017 Constituent Assembly, and political figure
notes: Constituent in the 2017 ANC and vice president of its Human Rights Commission; co-authored the 2018 economic proposal advocating the wealth tax.

name: Mario Silva
role: Presenter of La Hojilla (VTV), member of the 2017 Constituent Assembly and National Assembly deputy
notes: Longtime host of political broadcast La Hojilla; 2017 ANC constituent and deputy; co-authored the 2018 economic recommendations proposing the wealth tax.

name: Vladimir Adrianza
role: Economist and public analyst of energy and geopolitics
notes: Co-author of the 2018 recommendations. Public role: https://runrun.es/inicio/618999/proponen-que-acuerdo-energetico-con-ee-uu-sea-sometido-a-consulta-popular/

name: Andrés Giussepe
role: Economist, researcher and public commentator
notes: Co-author of the 2018 recommendations. Public role: https://comunidades.cepal.org/ilpes/es/usuarios/andres-giussepe

name: David Paravisini
role: Engineer and public analyst of energy policy
notes: Co-author of the 2018 recommendations. Public role: https://www.aporrea.org/energia/n423020.html

name: Judith Valencia
role: Economist, researcher and former professor at Universidad Central de Venezuela
notes: Co-author of the 2018 recommendations. Public role: https://www.mincultura.gob.ve/noticias/a-sus-88-anos-judith-valencia-celebra-sus-primeras-publicaciones/

name: Francisco Cedeño Lugo
role: Political writer and member of Red Angostura
notes: Public role and identity: https://redangostura.org.ve/archivos/17134

name: Alexis Corredor
role: Former constituent, electoral authority and labour minister
notes: Public role and identity: https://eldiario.com/2021/05/04/nuevos-rectores-del-cne-por-la-asamblea-nacional-oficialista/; party: https://radiocontactoalsur.wordpress.com/2026/03/05/venezuela-nuestro-norte-es-el-socialismo-a-los-desesperanzados-decimos-la-esperanza-esta-en-la-calle-entrevista-al-dirigente-sindical-alexis-corredor/

name: Edelberth Molina
role: Economist and researcher
notes: Public role and identity: https://www.clacso.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Programa-V-CONFERENCIA-CLACSO-VENEZUELA-2025.pdf

name: Agustín Calzadilla
role: Retired public law professor and political writer
notes: Public role and identity: https://www.aporrea.org/oposicion/a356389.html

name: Fernando Soto Rojas
role: National Assembly deputy and former constituent
notes: Public role and identity: https://redangostura.org.ve/archivos/17326; party: https://radioamerica.com.ve/jorge-rodriguez-fue-ratificado-presidente-de-la-asamblea-nacional/

name: José Gregorio Piña
role: Economist and public commentator
notes: Economist involved in the 2018 proposals, according to contemporaneous reporting: https://fedecamaras.org.ve/martes-05-de-junio-de-2018/

name: Marea Socialista
role: Venezuelan political organisation
notes: In July 2014 its draft conference document proposed a tax on gross personal wealth; https://mareasocialista.org/quienes-somos/ describes the organisation.

name: Plataforma Ciudadana en Defensa de la Constitución Bolivariana
role: Civic platform
notes: The platform authored the 2018 emergency programme. Later organisational status not established.
